notes.title: The Broken Republic - Gameplay Reveal Trailer Out!
notes.content:
Hello future presidents!

I know I haven't released all that much info about the game but that changes right now! For the past months, I've been working hard on this game and it's at a stage in which I'm confident enough to share it with you. I have released a gameplay reveal video where I go into great detail on what the game is about, the video is quite long so I wouldn't blame you for watching it in 2x speed.

Gameplay video
[previewyoutube=KmTANt8omzI;full][/previewyoutube]

Multiplayer
The video itself is me playing using the single-player version, which is almost finished. The multiplayer version is semi-functional but I am still working on certain parts of it, but the foundations are already there!

Release Date
It was my original goal to release the game in early July but this project was more ambitious than I expected. I am hoping to finish it by the end of July but due to personal reasons, this might be delayed by a month, for which I'm truly sorry.

Questions
If you have any questions or suggestions you can post them here or on the actual Youtube video! I'll try my best to respond as fast as I can.

Finally, I want to thank everyone who has wishlisted this game already, it means a lot! I'll try my best to release it as soon as I can and keep you updated!
